env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

! logos build -o op.bin ./op
stderr 'invalid operation'
! logos build -o method.bin ./method
stderr 'no field or method'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/simdgo

go 1.27

-- op/main.go --
package main

func main() {
	var a, b [4]int
	_ = a + b
}

-- method/main.go --
package main

func main() {
	var a [4]int
	_ = a.sum()
}
